struct Account { owner: text, balance: i64, kind: u8 }
enum WithdrawError { NotPositive, Insufficient }
fn withdraw(a: Account, amount: i64) -> Result<Account,WithdrawError> {
    if amount <= 0 { return err(NotPositive) }
    if amount > a.balance { return err(Insufficient) }
    return ok(Account { owner: a.owner, balance: a.balance - amount, kind: a.kind })
}
fn total(xs: Vec<Account>) -> i64 {
    return sum(x.balance for x in xs)
}
fn product(xs: Vec<i64>) -> Result<i64,ArithmeticError> {
    var p: i64 = 1
    for x in xs { p = try(p * x) }
    return ok(p)
}
fn owns(a: Account, name: text) -> bool {
    return a.owner == name
}
